app.title: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back
app.author: privacyisntdead
app.description: A shell script that disables Apple AI services on macOS 27 to free disk space.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run the install script
Execute the script with --help to verify help output
Run the script without arguments and confirm it reports disabling AI services
Check system logs to ensure AI services are stopped
Verify disk usage before and after to measure reclaimed space
